newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.3058 against U.S. dollar on Tuesday, from Monday's 8.3060 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.
The yuan opened down at an intra-day low of 8.3065 and rose slightly to consolidate around 8.3060 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.3054 before closing.
Trading was more active than on Monday with most done at 8.3060, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan was expected to rise further due to a large supply of U.S. dollars and in spite of intervention from the central bank.
"The yuan will touch the topside of 8.3050 in the next few days," one dealer said.
"If the yuan breaches 8.3050, it will meet further resistance at about 8.3000," a second dealer said.
Dealers expected the yuan to move steadily between 8.3050 and 8.3060 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed up at an intra-day high of 7.5911 from 7.6151 against 100 Japanese yen, and up at 1.0735 from 1.0750 against the Hong Kong dollar.
